description: ADCETRIS is indicated for the treatment of previously untreated adult patients with systemic anaplastic large cell lymphoma (sALCL), peripheral T-cell lymphoma-not otherwise specified (PTCL-NOS) or angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (AITL), whose tumours express CD30, in combination with cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone (CHP).
